item.title: Andrew.rs
item.description: What it is This portfolio/blog site with a Supabase instance as a backend, and a Dioxus static frontend. The frontend is compiled to webassembly, and hosted on Github pages for free. Why this stack Starting with Supabase: I prefer using a backend service like Supabase, because it saves a lot of time and effort on boilerplate things, such as authentication, interfacing with the database, and so on. item.title: LZMA + RLE Compression Library
item.description: View it on Github What it is A library ported from C to Rust that can encode or decode data using either LZMA compression, or a specific combination of LZMA and RLE. This algorithm is specifically tailored around a specific data format used to compress data for Playstation 2 disk images. More details/Why The existing tools available publicly for working with PS2 game data are all in a variety of different languages.
